applicability.scope: Pinned Lithos Metal 0.1.2 source/API contracts; Apple silicon Metal runtime; model and recipe qualification required separately.
applicability.prerequisites: Access to the pinned package/API and selected compiler, generation or serving contracts; revision/API drift needs a fresh bounded inspection, and efficacy claims need campaign-owned gates and matching native/model evidence.
applicability.input_contract: Actual source/package version, backend/configuration, chip/core count and OS, target/draft checkpoint identities, context and prompt-token IDs, sampling/numerical options and the affected recipe/runtime/session/cache boundary.
applicability.produced_artifact: A routed region/dependency, committed-state or cache-identity/lifecycle ledger, followed by the smallest supported finding, missing checks and next bounded action.
applicability.failure_modes: Treating session adoption/cache hits as generation correctness, fewer dispatches as faster rounds, another chip recipe as the default, CPU cache checks as GPU rollback or health liveness as loaded/warm model state can yield unsupported conclusions.

limitations: Source-derived candidate; empirical efficacy validation not_run.
CPU/software and synthetic Metal contracts do not qualify full-model/DSpark numerics, quality or E2E performance.
No model downloads, live DisCo deployment or inference backend integration is provided.
recommendations: Follow session replacement across recipe geometry, committed generation state and serving adoption/cache identity before interpreting a cache hit.
Keep an unfused/native or target-only control with matching decoded weights, numerical mode, row bounds and sampling policy; verify dependencies and persistent state before timing.
Distinguish package/CPU checks, synthetic Metal execution, model continuation and HTTP workload evidence; chip recipes and target-compute projections do not establish another device or E2E rate.
